Task: Batch Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that requests speaker diarization for a recorded meeting using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import assemblyai as aai
import sys
import time

def transcribe_meeting_with_diarization(audio_file_path: str, api_key: str) -> str:
    aai.settings.api_key = api_key
    
    config = aai.TranscriptionConfig(
        speaker_labels=True,
        language_code="en"
    )
    
    transcript = aai.Transcription.transcribe(audio_file_path, config)
    
    if transcript.status == aai.TranscriptStatus.error:
        return f"Transcription failed: {transcript.error}"
    
    if transcript.status != aai.TranscriptStatus.completed:
        return "Transcription not completed"
    
    if not hasattr(transcript, 'utterances') or not transcript.utterances:
        return transcript.text or "No transcription available"
    
    result = []
    for utterance in transcript.utterances:
        speaker = utterance.speaker
        text = utterance.text
        start = utterance.start / 1000  # ms to seconds
        end = utterance.end / 1000
        result.append(f"[{start:.1f}s - {end:.1f}s] Speaker {speaker}: {text}")
    
    return "\n".join(result)
```
